query:
SELECT
                c.id as entity_id,
                c.updated_at
            FROM comms_channels c
            INNER JOIN comms_channel_participants cp ON cp.channel_id = c.id
            WHERE cp.user_id = $1
                AND cp.left_at IS NULL
                AND c.id = ANY($2::uuid[])
                AND (
                    $3::timestamptz IS NULL
                    OR (c.updated_at, c.id) < ($3, $4)
                )
            ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC
